parts.label: (b)(iii)
parts.text:
The filament wires of the two lamps are made from material with the same resistivity at their operating temperature in the circuit. The diameter of the wire of lamp $P$ is twice the diameter of the wire of lamp $Q$.

Determine the ratio
$$\frac{\text{length of filament wire of lamp P}}{\text{length of filament wire of lamp Q}}.$$

parts.label: (b)(iv)
parts.text:
The filament wire of lamp $Q$ breaks and stops conducting.

State and explain, qualitatively, the effect on the resistance of lamp $P$.
